name: custompage-create
description: A custom page creation skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to create and publish a new custom page under a specified site language, with support for title, HTML content, and SEO fields.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to publish into, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it. First call `languages-get`, show the language list to the user, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

custompage.description: Required. Complete custom page payload for a new custom page. Treat this as the custom page that will actually be published.

title.description: Required. Custom page title shown to users, up to 100 characters.

content.description:
Required. HTML fragment only. Do not include any `

The 100,000-character limit is checked after removing `` tags, and the server uploads supported base64 images and replaces them with URL addresses. Before generating this field, call `rule-get` with the exact selected `language` and the exact scene value `custompage.content`. Do not guess, translate, normalize, shorten, or rename either `language` or `scene`. seo.description: Optional. SEO metadata for the custom page detail page.

title.description: Optional. Optimized title, up to 90 characters.

description.description: Optional. Optimized description, up to 200 characters.

keywords.description: Optional. SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, with up to 6 keywords and total length 120 characters or fewer.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact custom page creation request after seeing the final language and payload.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact custom page payload to be created. Never set this to `true` based on assumption.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact custom page payload shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

url.description: Preview URL for the created custom page. Always return this to the user and ask the user to preview it.
